statement: The Cyrillic extension of this font (Russian and Kazakh letters, their alternates, spacing and kerning) was made with the assistance of AI systems under the direction of a human author. The Latin is Instrument Serif, drawn by people, and is unchanged.
statement_ru: Кириллическое расширение шрифта (русские и казахские буквы, их альтернативы, поля и кернинг) сделано с помощью систем искусственного интеллекта под руководством автора-человека. Латиница — Instrument Serif, нарисована людьми, не изменена.
legal_basis: Law of the Republic of Kazakhstan No. 230-VIII of 17 November 2025 "On Artificial Intelligence", article 21 (transparency); in force from 18 January 2026
role_of_ai: Writing the build tools (tools/) and assembling Cyrillic outlines from parts of the Instrument Serif glyphs by measured rules; spacing and kerning by measurement.
human_contribution: the brief and the design instruction (docs/instruction.md)
the choice among variants, every rejection and correction, recorded with the author's words in CLAUDE.md
own drawings sent as SVG and embedded without changes: the vertical capital Tse with its tail and the drop-shaped tails
unchanged_human_work: Instrument Serif Latin by Rodrigo Fuenzalida with direction from Instrument (https://github.com/Instrument/instrument-serif)
where_marked: font metadata: name ID 10 (description) of every font file
